annotations.title: Text to speech (TTS): natural voices, audio file

description: Turn up to 300 characters of text into natural, human-sounding speech as an MP3 (base64), in English (40 voices) or Spanish (10 voices), with Deepgram Aura-2. Pick a voice by name or leave the default. Use for voice replies, audio notes, accessibility and phone or chat bots; for up to 2,000 characters use text_to_speech. Example: text=Your payment was received. Thank you!. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
